samples.player_text: Does anything make the work difficult today?
history: player
Hi Craftsman. What do you usually work on first thing in the morning?
npc
It's good to see you. Usually, I check the tools. A dull blade or loose handle can ruin a whole day. Then, whatever’s been drying overnight, I’ll look at that next. It’s a quiet start, mostly.
player
What part of that work matters most to you?
npc
The quiet, I suppose. It lets me see what needs doing. And it lets me remember what I’m trying to make. It's easy to forget, sometimes.
samples.candidate_dialogue: The humidity is high. Wood doesn't behave well when it's damp. It's a small thing, though. I’ll just need to be a little more careful.
